import random
from fractions import Fraction as F

def comb(x, y, z, A, B, C):
    return [x * A[i] + y * B[i] + z * C[i] for i in range(len(A))]

def collinear_pts(P1, P2, P3):
    # Points are collinear iff all 2x2 minors of [P2-P1; P3-P1] vanish.
    u = [P2[i] - P1[i] for i in range(len(P1))]
    w = [P3[i] - P1[i] for i in range(len(P1))]
    return all(u[i] * w[j] - u[j] * w[i] == 0
               for i in range(len(u)) for j in range(i + 1, len(u)))

def exact_ok(p, q):
    # Coefficients over (a, b, c):
    # P2-P1 = (1, 5, -7), P3-P1 = (-1, p+2, q-3).
    # Collinear for all a,b,c iff P3-P1 = s*(P2-P1) with constant s.
    u = (1, 5, -7)
    w = (-1, p + 2, q - 3)
    s = F(w[0], u[0])
    return all(w[i] == s * u[i] for i in range(3))

def sample_fail_count(p, q, trials=300, dim=4, seed=1):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    fails = 0
    for _ in range(trials):
        a = [rng.randint(-6, 6) for _ in range(dim)]
        b = [rng.randint(-6, 6) for _ in range(dim)]
        c = [rng.randint(-6, 6) for _ in range(dim)]
        P1 = comb(1, -2, 3, a, b, c)
        P2 = comb(2, 3, -4, a, b, c)
        P3 = comb(0, p, q, a, b, c)
        if not collinear_pts(P1, P2, P3):
            fails += 1
    return fails

submitted = (7, -10)
expected = (-7, 10)

sub_exact = exact_ok(*submitted)
sub_fails = sample_fail_count(*submitted)
exp_exact = exact_ok(*expected)
exp_fails = sample_fail_count(*expected)

print("Derived exact answer (p,q):", expected)
print("Submitted (p,q):", submitted)
print("Submitted exact coefficient check:", sub_exact)
print("Submitted sampled failures out of 300:", sub_fails)
print("Expected exact coefficient check:", exp_exact)
print("Expected sampled failures out of 300:", exp_fails)
print("Sampling supports counterexamples only; the exact coefficient check is the proof.")

print("CHECK PASS" if (exp_exact and exp_fails == 0 and not sub_exact and sub_fails > 0)
      else "CHECK FAIL")
